synthesis_schema.slot_index: 0..length-1 strictly contiguous, no duplicate/gap; not a bag index
synthesis_schema.property_id: exact member of property_pool; repeated properties across slots allowed
synthesis_schema.value: exact fixed value for property_id, no arbitrary user-entered value or inferred tier
synthesis_schema.origin_receipt_id: nonempty committed synthesis or mutation receipt owning this weapon lineage; no invented receipt during load
synthesis_schema.missing_field_or_unknown_property: reject configuration/snapshot; do not replace with empty/zero/default property
synthesis_schema.existing_initial_state: initial ordinary/hero instances already carry explicit empty array; no automatic synthesis grant

service_policy.qualification: exact weapon binding and actor class, meets weapon level/rank/route; all source growth valid and unreserved; no party/leader qualification
service_policy.additional_boost: nonzero attached enhancement display boost/temporary enhancement rejects these processing services before cost; never clear attached state
service_policy.unknown_other_growth: reject missing schema or damaged/unsupported nonzero inherited field, no loss of stored state
service_policy.weapon_checks_scope: source_location, weapon binding, weapon level/rank/route and source growth checks apply only synthesis/mutation; craft has no weapon input, uses explicit craft class/level/rank/route plus common NPC/alive/idle/combat/challenge checks

synthesis_recipes.property_choice: player chooses one exact property_pool member before quote
synthesis_recipes.success: append exactly one entry with fixed property value and committed receipt, same weapon instance ID
synthesis_recipes.failure: entries and source weapon unchanged; still consumes one material and5000 silver

divine_stone_craft.reward_ledger_effect: none; crafted stone never marks or resets zhen stage4/stage8 reward_stages

divine_mutation.chosen_slot: one exact currently occupied slot bound to quote, never choose another slot on stale input
divine_mutation.on_success: second logical uniform draw in[0,2] selects stable property_pool order excluding current property; replace chosen property/value/origin_receipt_id only
divine_mutation.on_failure: do not draw property; chosen entry and every source field unchanged
divine_mutation.cost_on_either_outcome: consume exactly one stone, fee0; no automatic refund/retry
divine_mutation.excluded_old_property: successful mutation always a different property_id, cannot return a successful identical property
divine_mutation.no_extra_paths: does not change slot count, enhancement, weapon stage, true flag, awakening or reward ledger

projection_policy.sum: sum identical property values across all active entries, with checked integer math; no derived cache persisted
projection_policy.attack: base weapon + real_enhancement attack + synthesis.attack_flat are distinct contributions to ordinary attack range; exactly once at accepted action
projection_policy.martial_order: declared hit flat skill power + eligible flat passive + registered real_enhancement martial flat + synthesis martial flat + registered jade martial flat + registered evolution martial flat + registered temporary enhancement boost martial flat + registered awakening martial flat + registered attribute_stone martial flat (including valid accepted Lu differential), then same-scope percentage passives once, then action attack and phase coefficient; normal basic/heal/status excluded
projection_policy.accuracy_evasion: derived persistent actor ratings from active equipped weapon, not a per-hit random buff; no percentage reinterpretation
projection_policy.lu_rule: all four contributions are synthesis, never attribute_stone; Lu weapon/armor attribute-stone doubling does not double these entries
projection_policy.points_and_hp: these four entries grant no qigong/anti-qigong points or maxHP/mana; do not invent extra slots or restore resources
projection_policy.progression_transfer: preserve exact legal entries/receipt ancestry across named weapon replacements; receipt binds lineage history rather than requiring origin receipt output instance==current instance
projection_policy.snapshot: accepted action snapshots relevant contributions so later mutation cannot rewrite already accepted attack; defense/evasion follow existing hit-time actor rules

transaction.preview: show exact target slot/old property, allowed outcomes and exact success/failure probability/cost, no hidden temporary buff or choose-after-draw
transaction.capacity: processing same instance/slot, only consumes material; craft removes5 material before allocating/stacking1 stone and checks final slots+weight. Cannot count a partially depleted stack as a free slot.
transaction.rng: clone requester RNG only after all qualification/cost/capacity/schema checks. Synthesis uses base plus valid supreme500bp capped10000 under supreme_processing_owner_ref; this never changes mutation/craft probabilities. Effective guaranteed synthesis and guaranteed craft do not draw. Other synthesis draws once against effective bp; mutation draws second property only on success. Uniform integer helper must avoid modulo bias.
transaction.atomic_commit: costs, chosen entry or crafted output, RNG state, source/character revisions and command receipt committed once on host
transaction.cancel_stale_invalid: no item/silver/random/revision change; do not pre-roll preview
transaction.duplicate: same command/payload returns original receipt before current slot validation, no new roll; changed payload with old command ID rejected
transaction.save_failure: keep committed memory/unsaved marker; save exact state again, never rerun material or random operation
transaction.lan: requester owns weapon/material/output/RNG; no shared party input/output
transaction.load: validate entry schema/property/value/receipt ancestry and unique lineage, reject damaged states; no clamping, dropping or normalizing unknown entries
